endpoint: GET https://api.koios.rest/api/v1/epoch_params?_epoch_no={epoch}, once per epoch, keyed by epoch in .response
source: Koios public API (no API key required)

identity.note: a protocol-parameter set carries no hash. Its checkable properties are that each cost_models entry reduces to a DENSE positional 0..n-1 parameter vector (mainnet serves an array; an index-keyed object is also accepted) and that the per-language count is compared against the arity the UPLC evaluator reads — a reading that can fail
